messages:
eden_sales: FYI Stratus ran a daytime soak and are seeing inconsistent first-byte times + occasional 429s. Peak ramp was ~180rps at 09:10 PT.

lina_sales: They're on a small dedicated pool (2-GPU). They want recommendations before we escalate to AE.

akshay_se: Can you share a representative request and any client-side error lines? Also which model + quantization they used?

eden_sales: Sample (redacted):
```
POST /v1/generate
model: redwood-2.1-medium-q8
body: {"prompt":"Summarize meeting notes","max_tokens":100}
headers: {"x-corp-id":"stratus-01"}
```
Client shows 429s in short bursts and TTFTs ~700-1,100ms for new connections.

marta_support: Do we have pool config? batch_window, concurrent_slots, prefill?

jun_sre: Pool=dedicated-18: 2xA100, batch_window=25ms, concurrent_slots=6, prefill=off. Per-shard rate limiter observed drops when queue_depth>45. KV cache hit rate is ~9% for this workload.

akshay_se: Low KV hit + prefill off explains much of the early token latency. For small prompts kernel init + memory IO dominate. Enabling a short prefill or pre-warm should help.

tom_se: Also seeing queueing imbalance on shard-2 during the ramp (queue_len spikes ~60). Could be routing affinity. We should try a balanced route policy or sprinkle traffic across more shards.

lina_sales: Customer is worried about token billing for prefill. Can we propose a controlled test cap?

akshay_se: Yes — propose: 10 tokens prefill per session for 2 minutes during the next ramp. We'll cap total prefill tokens at X for the POC (estimate attached in one-pager). Prefill counts as normal tokens.

stratus-cust: OK to a 2-minute test with 10-token prefill. We'll run the ramp again at 09:40 PT.

jun_sre: Deploying two temporary changes: 1) soft prefill job (10T, 2m) to pool dedicated-18; 2) route_override: route_policy=balanced for stratus-01 -> spreads across shards. Pushing now.

deploy-bot: warmup-job queued: pool=dedicated-18, job_id=wk-20240422-11, prefill_tokens=10

jun_sre: After warmup we saw median TTFT drop from ~900ms -> ~360ms for new sessions. KV hit improved to ~62%. However, isolated 429 spikes still occurred when short microbursts (3-6s) hit the same backend shard. Traces show per-shard limiter firing (token_bucket exhausted) at those times.

akshay_se: Two immediate mitigations: 1) decrease batch_window -> 8-12ms to reduce queue buildup for many small requests, 2) raise concurrent_slots to 10 to allow more in-flight small requests (watch GPU mem). Also recommend enabling route diversion to ephemeral pool when queue_depth>40.

lina_sales: I can put that into a one-page with cost impact. Do we support automatic per-customer queue_depth triggers today?

jun_sre: Not configurable in Console yet, but we can push a temporary route rule for the POC: if queue_depth>40 then route to pool-ephemeral-2. I'll apply it for the window.

marta_support: Action list: Jun apply route override + monitor dashboards; Akshay propose exact batch_window and concurrent_slots values and estimated cost delta; Lina send short note to Stratus on billing for prefill and the cap; Eden coordinate next ramp and collect 429 request IDs.

eden_sales: Running their 09:40 ramp now. Will post request IDs if 429s appear.

jun_sre: Monitoring — link: https://console.redwood/s/metrics/dedicated-18?range=15m (shared view). Seeing queue_depth flatten vs previous run.

stratus-cust: Saw large TTFT improvement during prefill window. We did capture three 429 ids: req_9a1f, req_b3c2, req_ef12 at 09:41:07-09:41:15. Sending logs now.

jun_sre: Correlated those IDs — 429s happened during a 4s microburst where shard-2 limiter hit. Route override diverted ~30% of traffic to ephemeral pool and prevented wider outage.

akshay_se: Follow-ups: 1) Recommend making soft-prefill default for small prompt workloads; 2) For production, consider tuning placement to avoid single-shard affinity for this customer; 3) For long-term, Console should expose per-customer fallback thresholds.

lina_sales: I'll summarize and include a short cost table: prefill 10T/session * avg concurrent sessions -> estimated additional tokens for the POC.

marta_support: We'll keep this POC open for 48h and then review. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
